- Get a free card for online or in-store purchases [1].
- Send and receive money, and sell via Pix [1].
- Receive your sales within 2 business days in the morning, if you choose that receiving option [1].
- Make transfers and pay bills [1].
- Withdraw at any Banco 24Horas [1].

There is an inactivity fee. If the account has no financial activity for 180 days, it is considered inactive. A fee of R$10.00 is then debited monthly until new transactions occur [2]. It is taken from the available balance, so it won't make your balance negative or harm your CPF/CNPJ [2].

A Getnet aceita bandeiras diferentes para pessoa física e para pessoa jurídica.
